label: lem:uniform_continuity
title: Uniform continuity on compact sets
statement: If $f$ is continuous on a closed interval $[a,b]$, then $f$ is uniformly continuous on $[a,b]$. In Mathlib this is \texttt{IsCompact.uniformContinuousOn\_of\_continuous}.
proof: This is the Heine--Cantor theorem: continuous functions on compact sets are uniformly continuous.
